001package org.clafer.frontend;
002
003/**
004 * The kinds of tokens.
005 */
006public enum TokenKind {
007    /**
008     * A name or a keyword, e.g., {@code c0_cost}, {@code abstract},
009     * {@code int}: keywords are recognized by the parser where they are
010     * expected, so a clafer may be named like one.
011     */
012    WORD,
013    /**
014     * A natural number, e.g., {@code 16}. A sign is a separate {@code -}.
015     */
016    INT,
017    /**
018     * A decimal number with digits on both sides of the point, e.g.,
019     * {@code 19.99}.
020     */
021    DECIMAL,
022    /**
023     * A double, a decimal number with an exponent, e.g., {@code 1.2e2} or
024     * {@code 1.0e-2}, as the compiler prints a {@code double} literal.
025     */
026    DOUBLE,
027    /**
028     * A string literal with its quotes and escapes as written, e.g.,
029     * {@code "a\"b"}; see {@link Lexer#unescape}.
030     */
031    STRING,
032    /**
033     * An operator or punctuation, e.g., {@code ->>}, {@code ..} or a brace.
034     */
035    SYMBOL,
036    /**
037     * A line or block comment. Comments are set aside, not passed to the
038     * parser.
039     */
040    COMMENT,
041    /**
042     * Text that is not a token, e.g., an unexpected character or an
043     * unterminated string. The lexer reports a diagnostic for it and goes on.
044     */
045    ERROR,
046    /**
047     * A reserved word of the full language, e.g., {@code abstract},
048     * {@code some} or {@code X} ({@link ClaferLexer}): it cannot name a
049     * clafer. The explicit languages have none ({@link #WORD}).
050     */
051    KEYWORD,
052    /**
053     * An escape to a backend, {@code [alloy| ... |]} or
054     * {@code [choco| ... |]}, set aside like a comment ({@link ClaferLexer}).
055     */
056    ESCAPE,
057    /**
058     * The start of a block of indented lines, an empty span: the opening
059     * brace that {@link Layout} inserts.
060     */
061    INDENT,
062    /**
063     * The end of a block of indented lines, an empty span: the closing
064     * brace that {@link Layout} inserts.
065     */
066    DEDENT,
067    /**
068     * The separator that {@link Layout} inserts between two lines at the
069     * same indentation, an empty span, so that, e.g., a group cardinality
070     * at the start of a line is not the cardinality of the clafer on the line
071     * before.
072     */
073    SEPARATOR,
074    /**
075     * The end of the input, an empty span after the last character.
076     */
077    EOF
078}
